task_description: Build a production-ready full-stack React+Express TypeScript web application for Shashkeey Madhyamik v Uchh Madhyamik Ashram Shala Pathraj - a tribal school management system with bilingual Marathi/English UI, role-based access, and 7 functional modules including admissions, attendance, hostel management, WhatsApp integration, clerk office, admin center, and AI assistant.
